items.stem: What distinguishes a flexible budget from a fixed budget?

options.text: A flexible budget is adjusted to the actual level of activity achieved
options.rationale: Correct: a flexible budget flexes cost and revenue allowances to the actual activity level.

options.text: A flexible budget is prepared only once a year
options.rationale: Frequency is not what defines flexing; adjusting to activity is.

options.text: A flexible budget ignores variable costs
options.rationale: Flexing specifically adjusts variable costs to activity.

options.text: A flexible budget is the same as the original fixed budget
options.rationale: If it were the same it would not be flexible.

options.rationale: Using only the best case ignores risk and is not a sound technique.
